description: A component whose whole render is a `<Teleport>`, with its own sheet, rendered by a styled parent: the teleported element takes the child's scoped styles and none of the parent's, and no target warns about the scope attributes the parent passes.
requires: Every test reads what the component teleports, which mounts in the browser once the component has mounted: Astro, which runs nothing there, renders none of it (ADR-0098).
